PublishingInfo.Description: Provides multilingual text-to-speech synthesis via OmniVoice, supporting 600+ languages with voice cloning, voice design, and auto voice modes.
PublishingInfo.Author: Hector47

RouteMaps.Name: Text to Speech
RouteMaps.Description: Synthesizes speech from text using OmniVoice. Supports three modes: voice cloning (provide ref_audio and optional ref_text), voice design (provide instruct with attributes like 'female, low pitch, british accent'), or auto voice (just provide text).

Inputs.Name: text
Inputs.Description: The text to be converted to speech.

Inputs.Name: ref_audio
Inputs.Description: (Optional) Reference audio file for voice cloning. If provided, the model will clone the voice from this audio.

Inputs.Name: ref_text
Inputs.Description: (Optional) Transcription of the reference audio. If omitted and ref_audio is provided, Whisper ASR will be used to auto-transcribe it.

Inputs.Name: instruct
Inputs.Description: (Optional) Voice design attributes (e.g., 'female, low pitch, british accent'). Used when no ref_audio is provided and you want to specify voice characteristics.

Inputs.Name: speed
Inputs.Description: Speed factor for speech generation. Values > 1.0 are faster, < 1.0 are slower.

Outputs.Name: success
Outputs.Description: True if speech was successfully synthesized.

Outputs.Name: audio
Outputs.Description: The synthesized audio as a base64-encoded WAV file.

Outputs.Name: inferenceMs
Outputs.Description: Time taken (ms) to perform the TTS inference.

Outputs.Name: processMs
Outputs.Description: Total time taken (ms) to process the request.

Outputs.Name: message
Outputs.Description: A descriptive message about the inference outcome.
